reason: I'd run the free 30 receipts to see what it finds, but then I'd just wire up my own thing with n8n, ChatGPT and a Google Sheet over a weekend. For a small rental shop that's free, and $19 every month is real money for me.
objection: It's a brand new little bot. If it disappears in six months my sheet stops updating and I'm back to scrolling the group chat at midnight, so why not build something I control myself?
would_change_my_mind: If the free report actually caught duplicate payments or wrong amounts I'd missed, worth more than a month's fee, and there was a plan under 100 documents for around $9 that keeps my data in my own sheet if they shut down.
